requirements.title: IEEE module availability and IEEE_FEATURES contents are processor dependent
requirements.source: S17.1 p1.support-purpose, p1.module-availability, p1.features-contents; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF479.
requirements.definition: IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, IEEE_ARITHMETIC, and IEEE_FEATURES provide support for ISO/IEC 60559:2020 facilities; the presence of the modules and the set of IEEE_FEATURES named constants are processor dependent.

pending.ieee-modules-provide-60559-support: Guard probe: compile a program using USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_ARITHMETIC, ONLY: IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE. TRUE branch: run it with default real sentinel 0.0 and assert the inquiry returns a logical scalar. FALSE branch: skip all module-dependent Clause 17 fixtures for that processor.
pending.ieee-module-provision-processor-dependen: No portable oracle requires any processor to provide these modules; a catalogue-level capability profile records the compile result and treats absence as unsupported, not conforming evidence.
pending.ieee-features-named-constant-set-process: No portable oracle requires a particular IEEE_FEATURES named constant to be present; fixtures for a feature constant first compile a USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_FEATURES, ONLY: that constant probe and skip the absent branch.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. IEEE effects are tested only under explicit capability probes; the TRUE branch asserts the concrete flag, mode, type, constant, or operation effect, and the FALSE branch is a skip rather than a pass. Named FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(flag,x): under IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,x), if IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag) then CALL IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(flag,.FALSE.); else CALL IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(flag,h) and proceed only if h is .FALSE. (otherwise skip); CALL IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_ALL,.FALSE.). Positive plans establish a non-default state first by setting distinguished sentinel values and apply FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE before any exception operation or flag-state assertion unless the row explicitly says the preamble is not applied because it would destroy the initial-state oracle.

requirements.title: IEEE_ARITHMETIC makes IEEE_EXCEPTIONS public entities public
requirements.source: S17.1 p1.arithmetic-reexports-exceptions; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF479.
requirements.definition: IEEE_ARITHMETIC behaves as though it used IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, so every public entity of IEEE_EXCEPTIONS is public through IEEE_ARITHMETIC.

pending.ieee-arithmetic-reexports-ieee-exception: Guard probe: compile USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_ARITHMETIC, ONLY: IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_GET_FLAG. TRUE branch: call IEEE_GET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,flag_value) into a logical initialized .true. and assert the call is valid plus the result is a logical scalar; FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE is referenced but not applied because this callability row does not assert a flag state. FALSE branch: skip module-public propagation checks.

requirements.title: Access to exception modules guarantees overflow and divide-by-zero support for IEEE data and exposes inquiries
requirements.source: S17.1 p2.baseline-exception-support, p2.inquiries; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF479.
requirements.definition: In a scoping unit with IEEE_EXCEPTIONS or IEEE_ARITHMETIC accessible, IEEE_OVERFLOW and IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO are supported for every IEEE real and complex floating-point kind, and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG and IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING inquire about other exception and halting support.

pending.overflow-supported-for-ieee-real-kinds: Guard probe: for each real kind X in the fixture profile with IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,X) true. Apply FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(IEEE_OVERFLOW,X). TRUE branch: compute HUGE(X)*HUGE(X) through volatile variables and assert IEEE_GET_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW) returns signaling. FALSE branch: skip that kind.
pending.divide-by-zero-supported-for-ieee-real-k: Guard probe: for each profiled real kind X with IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO,X) true. Apply FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO,X). TRUE branch: compute 1.0_X/0.0_X through volatile variables and assert IEEE_GET_FLAG(IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO) returns signaling. FALSE branch: skip that kind.
pending.overflow-divide-supported-for-ieee-compl: Guard probe: for each profiled real kind X with IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG true for IEEE_OVERFLOW and IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO. Apply the FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE for IEEE_OVERFLOW before the overflow case and for IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO before the divide case: if IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(FLAG) then CALL IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(FLAG,.FALSE.); else CALL IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(FLAG,h) and proceed only if h is .FALSE. (otherwise skip); CALL IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_ALL,.FALSE.). TRUE branch: complex multiplication causing a part overflow signals IEEE_OVERFLOW, and complex division by a zero part signals IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO. FALSE branch: skip that kind.
pending.support-flag-inquires-other-exceptions: Guard probe: compile USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, ONLY: IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG. TRUE branch: call IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID, 0.0) into a logical initialized .true. and assert only logical scalar callability. FALSE branch: skip optional-flag support effects.
pending.support-halting-inquires-halting-control: Guard probe: compile USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, ONLY: IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING. TRUE branch: call IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW) into a logical initialized .true. and assert logical scalar callability. FALSE branch: skip halting-control effects.

requirements.title: Accessible IEEE_FEATURES exception constants require minimum support
requirements.source: S17.1 p2.features-minimum-exception-support; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF479.
requirements.definition: Accessibility of IEEE_UNDERFLOW_FLAG, IEEE_INEXACT_FLAG, IEEE_INVALID_FLAG, or IEEE_HALTING requires support for the corresponding exception for at least one real kind or for halting control in the scoping unit.

pending.accessible-underflow-flag-requires-some-: Guard probe: compile with USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_FEATURES, ONLY: IEEE_UNDERFLOW_FLAG and a generated profile containing candidate real kinds. TRUE branch: at least one profiled candidate has IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_UNDERFLOW,X) true; for that candidate, apply FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(IEEE_UNDERFLOW,X), then guarded inexact TINY(X)/3.0_X sets IEEE_UNDERFLOW. FALSE branch: record an inconclusive profile gap rather than a pass.
pending.accessible-inexact-flag-requires-some-re: Guard probe: compile with USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_FEATURES, ONLY: IEEE_INEXACT_FLAG and generated candidate real kinds. TRUE branch: at least one candidate has IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INEXACT,X) true; for that candidate, apply FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(IEEE_INEXACT,X), then volatile 1.0_X/3.0_X sets IEEE_INEXACT. FALSE branch: record an inconclusive profile gap rather than a pass.
pending.accessible-invalid-flag-requires-some-re: Guard probe: compile with USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_FEATURES, ONLY: IEEE_INVALID_FLAG and generated candidate real kinds. TRUE branch: at least one candidate has IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID,X) true; for that candidate, apply FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(IEEE_INVALID,X), then SQRT(-1.0_X) sets IEEE_INVALID. FALSE branch: record an inconclusive profile gap rather than a pass.
pending.accessible-ieee-halting-requires-halting: Guard probe: compile with USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_FEATURES, ONLY: IEEE_HALTING. TRUE branch: IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW) or another supported flag is true, then IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(flag,.FALSE.) and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE round-trip .FALSE.; no halting .TRUE. run is executed. FALSE branch: skip.

requirements.title: Scoping units without IEEE module access have processor-dependent support but preserve signaling flags
requirements.source: S17.1 p3.no-access-support-latitude, p3.signaling-entry-preserved, p3.quiet-entry-latitude; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF479.
requirements.definition: A scoping unit without IEEE_FEATURES, IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, or IEEE_ARITHMETIC has a processor-dependent support level; a flag signaling on entry is signaling on exit, while a flag quiet on entry has processor-dependent exit state.

pending.no-ieee-module-access-support-processor-: No portable oracle requires exception support in a no-access scoping unit; fixtures use the caller capability profile and make no support claim inside the no-access procedure.
pending.no-access-signaling-flag-preserved-on-ex: Guard probe: caller with IEEE_EXCEPTIONS support and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_OVERFLOW,X) true applies FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE(IEEE_OVERFLOW,X), then sets IEEE_OVERFLOW signaling and calls an external subroutine whose source has no IEEE USE statements and performs only integer sentinel assignment. TRUE branch: caller observes IEEE_OVERFLOW still signaling after return. FALSE branch: skip unsupported flag.
pending.no-access-quiet-flag-exit-state-processo: No portable oracle fixes the exit state from a no-access subroutine entered with a quiet flag; FLAG-ROW-PREAMBLE is referenced but not applied because either quiet or signaling on return is permitted and future fixtures must not fail either state.

requirements.title: Accessible IEEE_FEATURES arithmetic constants require minimum arithmetic feature support
requirements.source: S17.1 p4.arithmetic-facilities, p4.features-minimum-arithmetic-support, p4.rounding-minimum-modes; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF479.
requirements.definition: IEEE_ARITHMETIC provides additional 60559 facilities, and accessibility of IEEE_FEATURES constants requires support for the named arithmetic feature for at least one real kind; IEEE_ROUNDING requires IEEE_NEAREST, IEEE_TO_ZERO, IEEE_UP, and IEEE_DOWN, plus IEEE_AWAY for a decimal IEEE datatype kind.

pending.ieee-arithmetic-additional-facilities-av: Guard probe: compile USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_ARITHMETIC, ONLY: IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN, IEEE_SUPPORT_INF, IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT. TRUE branch: each inquiry is callable with default real and returns a logical scalar initialized from a sentinel. FALSE branch: skip arithmetic-facility checks.
pending.accessible-ieee-datatype-requires-some-r: Guard probe: compile with USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_FEATURES, ONLY: IEEE_DATATYPE and generated candidate real kinds. TRUE branch: at least one candidate has IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true and exact 1.5_kind + 0.25_kind yields 1.75_kind. FALSE branch: record an inconclusive profile gap rather than a pass.
pending.accessible-ieee-denormal-or-subnormal-re: Guard probe: compile separately for IEEE_DENORMAL and IEEE_SUBNORMAL accessibility. TRUE branch: at least one profiled kind has IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true for the IEEE_CLASS observer and IEEE_SUPPORT_DENORMAL(X) or IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(X) true; under IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(X) true, the fixture first sets gradual underflow and observes TINY(X)/RADIX(X) with IEEE_CLASS as subnormal; under IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(X) false, it observes only a nonzero supported-subnormal result and does not assert the mode effect. FALSE branch: record an inconclusive profile gap rather than a pass.
pending.accessible-ieee-divide-inf-nan-sqrt-requ: Guard probe: compile each accessible constant IEEE_DIVIDE, IEEE_INF, IEEE_NAN, IEEE_SQRT and generated candidate real kinds. TRUE branch: at least one candidate satisfies the matching IEEE_SUPPORT_* inquiry, and any IEEE_VALUE, IEEE_CLASS, or IEEE_IS_NAN observer is invoked only in the IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true branch; concrete observations are 1.0_X/2.0_X == 0.5_X, IEEE_VALUE positive infinity classified as positive infinity, IEEE_VALUE quiet NaN observed by IEEE_IS_NAN, and SQRT(4.0_X)==2.0_X. FALSE branch: record an inconclusive profile gap rather than a pass.
pending.accessible-ieee-rounding-requires-four-d: Guard probe: compile with IEEE_ROUNDING accessible and choose a profiled radix-two kind with IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING true for IEEE_NEAREST, IEEE_TO_ZERO, IEEE_UP, and IEEE_DOWN. TRUE branch: IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE plus IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE round-trips each mode, then 1.0 + EPSILON(1.0)/2.0 gives the directed tie results. FALSE branch: record an inconclusive profile gap rather than a pass.
pending.decimal-ieee-datatype-requires-ieee-away: Guard probe: find a profiled real kind with IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true and RADIX(X)==10. TRUE branch: IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_AWAY,X) is true and set/get round-trips IEEE_AWAY. FALSE branch: skip because no decimal IEEE datatype kind is observed.

requirements.title: Feature subsets and maximal IEEE feature support depend on IEEE_FEATURES accessibility
requirements.source: S17.1 p5.performance-latitude, p5.no-features-subset-latitude, p5.fullest-support-with-features; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF479.
requirements.definition: Support can slow execution; without IEEE_FEATURES the supported subset is processor dependent, and accessing all IEEE_FEATURES requests the processor fullest support.

pending.ieee-feature-support-performance-latitud: No portable oracle constrains execution speed changes caused by IEEE feature support; future tests must not compare timings.
pending.no-ieee-features-supported-subset-proces: No portable oracle fixes the feature subset in a program using IEEE_ARITHMETIC without IEEE_FEATURES; fixtures record the observed capability branch and skip absent features.
pending.access-all-ieee-features-requests-fulles: Guard probe: compile a control using IEEE_ARITHMETIC alone and a companion adding USE, INTRINSIC :: IEEE_FEATURES. TRUE branch: compare only monotone inquiry facts fixed by this section, such as a feature constant accessibility enabling its minimum-support guarded branch; do not require a particular processor-dependent feature set. FALSE branch: skip absent constants.
